descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team. The successful candidate is someone with a deep understanding of legal and regulatory requirements pertaining to the crypto-asset industry in Argentina, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
The successful candidate will report directly to the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, serving as the primary point of contact for regulatory and licensing matters within Argentina. This is a senior position designed for professionals with proven experience engaging with or working within financial regulators, supervisory authorities, or policy-making bodies. The ideal candidate combines strategic insight with hands-on execution, demonstrates a diplomatic, solutions-oriented approach in navigating complex regulatory environments, and is able to anticipate regulatory changes and adapt strategies proactively to evolving market and legal environments. You will represent the company in regulatory discussions, contribute to regional initiatives under the guidance of the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, and ensure local implementation aligns with the company’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.
To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, crypto-assets and the regulatory requirements. Engage with industry associations, chambers, and other stakeholder groups to promote innovation and collaboration.

You will have a focus around translating regulatory requirements in Argentina into clear and actionable strategic recommendations, managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business.

Responsibilities

• Regulatory Strategy Development: development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s in the region from which to operate. Ensure local implementation aligns with Tether’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.

• Regulatory Advocacy and Collaboration : participating in regulatory agency interactions, engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for stablecoin issuers, advocating for policies that promote innovation while ensuring safety and compliance. Actively contribute to public consultations, working groups, and industry forums, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and institutional diplomacy.

• Policy Analysis and Guidance : Provide analysis on local regulatory proposals, and advise the business on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance. Produce concise internal policy briefs and recommendations to inform senior management decision-making.

• Regulatory approval process : contribute to the process of obtaining necessary license approvals in identified markets, where appropriate. Support the preparation and coordination of documentation and responses to regulatory inquiries, ensuring strategic consistency and accuracy.

• Cross-functional Leadership : Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., expansion, legal, compliance, finance) to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and to proactively address emerging regulatory challenges. Serve as the local regulatory lead, ensuring effective communication and alignment with regional priorities.

• Minimum of 5 years regulatory experience within the financial services or crypto-asset industry.

• Preferred: Minimum of 5–8 years regulatory experience within financial services, fintech, or crypto-asset industries.

• Ability to apply knowledge of key regulatory frameworks in Argentina both strategically and operationally and provide direction to resolve complex regulatory issues.

• Demonstrated diplomatic skills and ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships.

• Expertise in preparing regulatory analysis including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities, such as regulatory consultation response submissions.

• Proven experience working with or within regulatory authorities (e.g., central banks, financial supervisory agencies, or ministries of finance) is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to draft or contribute to public policy responses, regulatory filings, or industry position papers.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must have hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently, with excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Fluency in English and native proficiency in the local language of Argentina.

• University degree.

• Advanced degree in Law, Economics, Political Science, or a related field preferred.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Why Join Us?

We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally.

The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology.

QVAC is a cutting-edge development platform designed for building privacy-focused AI applications. Unlike traditional AI tools that rely heavily on cloud-based infrastructure, QVAC is designed to run entirely on local devices, giving users full control over their data.

Responsibilities
 Developer Advocacy & Community Building

• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.

• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.

• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.

• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities.

Technical Content & Enablement

• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.

• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.

• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.

• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions.

Product Evangelism

• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.

• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.

• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.

• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.

• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.

• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners

Thought Leadership

• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.

• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.

• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.

• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.

• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.

• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.

• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.

• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.

• Strong experience with Llama.cpp and ggml inference engines, which facilitates the deployment of models to specific GPU architectures

• Experience with AI or ML technologies, such as building or integrating LLMs, chatbots, or AI-driven SDKs and APIs.

• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement.

Preferred

• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.

• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).

• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.

• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency

• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.

• Understanding of DevRel success metrics - content reach, community engagement, and product adoption.

• Experience in technical writing, developer education, or public speaking.

• Passion for community building, mentoring, and empowering developers through content and collaboration.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere i gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali pionieristici.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro

L'obiettivo primario di una relazione degli sviluppatori è quello di coinvolgere, educare, e ispirare la comunità degli sviluppatori - costruire la fiducia, guidare l'adozione della nostra tecnologia, e garantire agli sviluppatori un'esperienza eccezionale con i nostri prodotti. Ciò comporta la creazione di contenuti tecnici, presentando eventi, raccogliendo feedback e servendo come voce dello sviluppatore sia esternamente che internamente.

Il ruolo è focalizzato sul colmare il divario tra gli sviluppatori e i nostri team di prodotti, assicurando che le nostre soluzioni siano accessibili, ben comprese e amichevoli per gli sviluppatori, promuovendo la crescita della comunità, promuovendo le migliori pratiche e promuovendo un miglioramento continuo nel modo in cui gli sviluppatori scoprono, imparano e costruiscono con la nostra tecnologia.

QVAC è una piattaforma di sviluppo all'avanguardia progettata per la costruzione di applicazioni AI focalizzate sulla privacy. A differenza dei tradizionali strumenti AI che si basano fortemente sulle infrastrutture basate su cloud, QVAC è progettato per funzionare interamente su dispositivi locali, dando agli utenti il pieno controllo sui loro dati.

responsabilità
Sviluppatore Advocacy & Community Building

• Costruire e nutrire relazioni con sviluppatori, partner e comunità open source.

Contenuto Tecnico & Abilitazione

• Contribuisci a migliorare l'esperienza degli sviluppatori attraverso il feedback della documentazione, i flussi di bordo e i suggerimenti di progettazione API.

Prodotto Evangelismo

• Traduci concetti tecnici complessi in proposte di valore chiare e relatable.

• Collabora con il marketing per allineare la narrazione tecnica con la messaggistica di marca più ampia.

• Traccia e segnala le metriche del sentimento e dell'adozione della comunità per misurare l'impatto evangelistico.

Collaborazione trasversale

• Collabora a stretto contatto con l'ingegneria, la gestione dei prodotti e il marketing per allineare le esigenze degli sviluppatori con la strategia del prodotto.

• Fornire loop di feedback strutturati tra sviluppatori esterni e team interni per migliorare l'usabilità del prodotto.

• Supporta le strategie di lancio per le nuove funzionalità, API e SDK.

• Contribuire alle discussioni sulla roadmap per garantire che l'esperienza degli sviluppatori rimanga una priorità strategica.

• Sostenere le prime discussioni tecniche con potenziali clienti e partner

Leadership del pensiero

• Rimanete al passo con le tendenze, gli strumenti e le strutture del settore rilevanti per la comunità degli sviluppatori.

• Squadre interne Mentor su efficaci pratiche di comunicazione dello sviluppatore e di impegno della comunità.

• Laurea in Informatica, ingegneria del software, o campo relativo - o equivalente esperienza professionale.

• 3+ anni di esperienza di sviluppo software professionale.

• Esperienza precedente come Sviluppatore Avvocato, Rapporti Sviluppatori, o Technical Community Manager.

• Forte esperienza pratica con JavaScript, TypeScript e Node.js - in grado di scrivere codice di livello di produzione e spiegarlo chiaramente ad altri sviluppatori.

• Dimostrata esperienza costruzione, test e manutenzione di applicazioni o API.

• Prova capacità di creare contenuti tecnici (tutoriali, progetti di campionamento, post sul blog, video o documentazione) che educa e ispira sviluppatori.

• Comprensione delle metriche di successo DevRel - la portata dei contenuti, l'impegno della comunità e l'adozione dei prodotti.

• Passione per la costruzione di comunità, il mentoring e il potenziamento degli sviluppatori attraverso il contenuto e la collaborazione.

Informazioni importanti per i candidati

• Doppio check indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalarlo immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally.

The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology.

QVAC is a cutting-edge development platform designed for building privacy-focused AI applications. Unlike traditional AI tools that rely heavily on cloud-based infrastructure, QVAC is designed to run entirely on local devices, giving users full control over their data.

Responsibilities
Developer Advocacy & Community Building

• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.

• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.

• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.

• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities.

Technical Content & Enablement

• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.

• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.

• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.

• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions.

Product Evangelism

• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.

• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.

• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.

• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.

• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.

• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners

Thought Leadership

• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.

• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.

• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.

• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.

• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.

• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.

• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.

• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.

• Strong experience with Llama.cpp and ggml inference engines, which facilitates the deployment of models to specific GPU architectures

• Experience with AI or ML technologies, such as building or integrating LLMs, chatbots, or AI-driven SDKs and APIs.

• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement.

Preferred

• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.

• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).

• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.

• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency

• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.

• Understanding of DevRel success metrics - content reach, community engagement, and product adoption.

• Experience in technical writing, developer education, or public speaking.

• Passion for community building, mentoring, and empowering developers through content and collaboration.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Treten Sie Tether bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen
Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Vorreiter einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere innovativen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen - von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsprozessoren und Geldautomaten -, reservegestützte Token nahtlos in Blockchains zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie können Sie digitale Token sofort, sicher und global zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten speichern, senden und empfangen. Transparenz ist das Fundament von allem, was wir tun, und gewährleistet das Vertrauen in jede Transaktion.

Innovation mit Tether
Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite verfügt über den weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte von Millionen Menschen weltweit verlassen, neben bahnbrechenden Tokenisierungsdiensten für digitale Vermögenswerte.
Aber das ist erst der Anfang:
Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen, die nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben, optimieren überschüssige Energie für den Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in hochmodernen, geodiversen Anlagen.
Tether Data: Durch die Förderung von Durchbrüchen in der KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie senken wir die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit innovativen Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert.
Tether Education: Indem wir den Zugang zu erstklassigem digitalem Lernen demokratisieren, befähigen wir Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaften zu gedeihen und das globale Wachstum und die Chancen zu fördern.
Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf leistungsstarke, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen.

Warum mitmachen?
Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das aus allen Ecken der Welt fern arbeitet. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job

Das primäre Ziel einer Entwicklerbeziehung ist es, die Entwicklergemeinschaft zu engagieren, zu erziehen und zu inspirieren - Vertrauen aufzubauen, die Einführung unserer Technologie voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass Entwickler eine außergewöhnliche Erfahrung mit unseren Produkten haben. Dies beinhaltet das Erstellen von technischen Inhalten, das Präsentieren bei Veranstaltungen, das Sammeln von Feedback und die externe und interne Stimme des Entwicklers.

Die Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Überbrückung der Lücke zwischen Entwicklern und unseren Produktteams, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Lösungen zugänglich, gut verstanden und entwicklerfreundlich sind, während das Wachstum der Community gefördert, Best Practices gefördert und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Art und Weise, wie Entwickler unsere Technologie entdecken, lernen und entwickeln, vorangetrieben wird.

QVAC ist eine innovative Entwicklungsplattform, die für die Erstellung datenschutzorientierter KI-Anwendungen entwickelt wurde. Im Gegensatz zu herkömmlichen KI-Tools, die stark auf Cloud-basierte Infrastruktur angewiesen sind, ist QVAC so konzipiert, dass es vollständig auf lokalen Geräten läuft und den Benutzern die volle Kontrolle über ihre Daten gibt.

• Entwickeln Sie Demos, Prototypen und Referenzimplementierungen, die reale Anwendungsfälle zeigen.

• Unterstützen Sie das Entwickler-Onboarding durch Workshops, Hackathons und Schulungen.

Produkt-Evangelisation

Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

Thought Leadership

Bevorzugt

Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten
Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich für Rollen bewerben:

• Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist eindeutig angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen.

• Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @ tether.to oder @ tether.io enden.

• Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details verlangen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, ist dies ein Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es sofort.

Im Zweifelsfall können Sie sich über unsere offizielle Website informieren.

Joindre Tether et façonner l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises – des échanges et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets – d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début :
Tether Power: moteur de la croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisation de l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talent, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail

L'objectif premier d'une relation développeur est d'engager, d'éduquer et d'inspirer la communauté développeur - de renforcer la confiance, de stimuler l'adoption de notre technologie et de faire en sorte que les développeurs aient une expérience exceptionnelle avec nos produits. Il s'agit de créer du contenu technique, de présenter des événements, de recueillir des commentaires et de servir de voix du développeur à la fois externe et interne.

Le rôle consiste à combler l'écart entre les développeurs et nos équipes de produits, à s'assurer que nos solutions sont accessibles, bien comprises et adaptées aux développeurs, tout en favorisant la croissance communautaire, en favorisant les meilleures pratiques et en favorisant l'amélioration continue de la façon dont les développeurs découvrent, apprennent et construisent avec notre technologie.

QVAC est une plateforme de développement de pointe conçue pour construire des applications d'IA axées sur la vie privée. Contrairement aux outils d'IA traditionnels qui dépendent fortement de l'infrastructure basée sur le cloud, QVAC est conçu pour fonctionner entièrement sur des appareils locaux, donnant aux utilisateurs un plein contrôle sur leurs données.

Responsabilités
Défense des intérêts des développeurs et renforcement de la communauté

• Établir et entretenir des relations avec les développeurs, les partenaires et les communautés à source ouverte.

• Engagez-vous et interagissez avec l'écosystème développeur – hébergez des AMA, des heures de bureau, des webinaires et jouez un rôle dans les communautés en ligne.

• Recueillir et synthétiser les commentaires des développeurs pour informer les équipes de produits et d'ingénierie.

• Identifier les promoteurs, les projets et les collectivités influents afin d'établir des possibilités de collaboration.

Contenu technique & Activation

• Créez et maintenez un contenu technique de haute qualité (blog, tutoriels, exemples d'applications, vidéos, documentation, guides SDK, etc.) directement destiné aux développeurs.

• Développez des démos, des prototypes et des implémentations de référence qui présentent des cas d'utilisation dans le monde réel.

• Contribuer à améliorer l'expérience du développeur grâce à la rétroaction documentaire, aux flux d'embarquement et aux suggestions de conception d'API.

• Soutenez le développeur à bord par des ateliers, des hackathons et des séances de formation.

Évangélisation des produits

• Advocate for the company's technology stack lors d'événements industriels, de rencontres de développeurs et de communautés en ligne.

• Traduire des concepts techniques complexes en propositions de valeur claires et relatables.

• Collaborer avec le marketing pour aligner la narration technique avec la messagerie de marque plus large.

• Suivre et signaler le sentiment communautaire et les mesures d'adoption pour mesurer l'impact de l'évangélisation.

Collaboration interfonctionnelle

• Partenaire étroitement avec l'ingénierie, la gestion des produits et le marketing pour aligner les besoins des développeurs sur la stratégie des produits.

• Fournir des boucles de rétroaction structurées entre les développeurs externes et les équipes internes pour améliorer la convivialité des produits.

• Soutenir les stratégies de lancement pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités, API et SDK face aux développeurs.

• Contribuer aux discussions sur la feuille de route pour s'assurer que l'expérience du développeur demeure une priorité stratégique.

• Soutenir les discussions techniques initiales avec les clients et partenaires potentiels

Leadership de la pensée

• Représenter l'entreprise comme une voix technique crédible dans l'écosystème par des interventions publiques, des contributions de source ouverte et l'engagement communautaire.

• Restez en avance sur les tendances, les outils et les cadres de l'industrie pertinents pour la communauté des promoteurs.

• Mentor équipes internes sur la communication efficace des développeurs et les pratiques d'engagement communautaire.

• Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, ou domaine connexe - ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

• 3+ ans d'expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel.

• Expérience antérieure en tant que défenseur des développeurs, responsable des relations avec les développeurs ou responsable de la communauté technique.

• Forte expérience pratique avec JavaScript, TypeScript et Node.js - capable d'écrire un code de niveau de production et de l'expliquer clairement aux autres développeurs.

• Expérience démontrée de construction, de test et de maintenance d'applications ou d'API.

• Capacité éprouvée de créer des contenus techniques (tutoriels, exemples de projets, billets de blog, vidéos ou documentation) qui éduquent et inspirent les développeurs.

• Expérience de présentation lors d'événements publics, comme des conférences de développeurs, des rencontres, des webinaires ou des discussions internes d'entreprises.

• Excellente capacité de communication et de présentation, écrite et verbale, avec la capacité de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en messages simples et engageants.

• Expérience d'engagement avec les communautés de développeurs à travers des événements, GitHub, des forums ou des médias sociaux.

• Connaissance approfondie des principes et des pratiques exemplaires de l'expérience du développeur.

• Capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les équipes de produits, d'ingénierie et de marketing.

• Forte expérience avec les moteurs à inférence Llama.cpp et ggml, ce qui facilite le déploiement de modèles dans des architectures GPU spécifiques

• Expérience des technologies d'IA ou de ML, comme la construction ou l'intégration de LLM, de chatbots ou de SDK et d'API pilotés par l'IA.

• Connaissance de l'anglais — Des compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite et verbale sont requises pour le contenu public et l'engagement des développeurs.

Préféré

• Expérience de conception, de documentation ou de promotion des SDK ou des outils de développement.

• Expérimentez le développement ou l'intégration d'applications (web, mobile ou bureautique).

• 4-6 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels ou les relations de développeurs.

• Expérience d'utilisation d'outils d'IA (tels que Cursor, Codex ou des workflows de développement assistés par l'IA) pour améliorer la productivité et l'efficacité de résolution de problèmes

• Contributions à des projets ouverts ou à l'entretien de dépôts publics GitHub.

• Compréhension des mesures de réussite DevRel - portée du contenu, engagement communautaire et adoption de produits.

• Expérience dans l'écriture technique, l'éducation des développeurs ou l'expression publique.

• Passion pour le développement communautaire, le mentorat et l'autonomisation des développeurs par le contenu et la collaboration.

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit au moment de postuler pour des rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait au moyen de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Wallets (100% remote Worldwide)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 In this pivotal role, you will leverage your expertise to build robust, scalable, and secure backend solutions that contribute to Tether’s mission of pioneering a decentralized future in digital finance. This is an opportunity to take on formidable challenges and make a significant impact on our cutting-edge, global platform.

Responsibilities

• Innovative Solutions: Contribute to the creation of groundbreaking projects, utilizing agile methodologies and innovative technologies to create incredible platforms.

• Scalability: Ensure backend services remain effortlessly responsive and real-time, accommodating the platform's continual growth and evolving user base.

• Security: Uphold the highest security standards in all backend processes and services to safeguard our users' assets and data.

• Node/JavaScript Expertise: Very proficient in Node.js and JavaScript programming.

• Microservices Architecture: Familiarity with microservices architecture for scalable applications.

• Complex Platform Development: Experience in actively developing complex platforms.

• Peer-to-Peer Technologies: Understanding of Peer-to-Peer technologies.

• Database Interaction: Proficiency in interacting with databases such as MySQL and MongoDB.

• Quick Learner: Ability to quickly adapt and learn new technologies.

• Security Awareness: Strong understanding and experience implementing best security practices.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team, to lead efforts in the Southern Africa Region. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the crypto-asset industry / stablecoin industry in the country, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
 To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, and regulatory requirements.
 You will have a focus around working with regulators to translate policy objectives of the companies into favourable regulatory requirements in the applicable countries, as part of enabling the broader business strategy. From time to time, this may also include working on obtaining regulatory authorisations / approvals.
 The successful candidate should be comfortable managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business, including regulators and policy setters, as well as working with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Finance, Technology, Business Development.
 You will report to the Head of Regulatory and Licensing Affairs-Africa, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory and licensing initiatives.

Responsibilities
 Regulatory Affairs

• Monitor regulatory developments impacting Tether and affiliates companies in the Southern Africa Region.

• Maintain active relationships with policymakers, regulators, central banks, and financial intelligence units.

• Represent the company in consultations, workshops, industry roundtables, and regulatory dialogues.

• Prepare briefing papers, comment letters, and policy submissions aligned with broader global regulatory strategy.

• Identify opportunities to shape emerging frameworks in a risk-sensitive, innovation-oriented manner.

Licensing & Authorisations

• Conduct structured assessments on whether licensing/registration is required for operations in the country.

• Lead or support licensing applications end-to-end - where needed - including preparation of supplementary documentation, legal opinion coordination, regulator communications, and post-submission follow-up.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Provide actionable risk and regulatory insights to internal stakeholders (legal, product, compliance, risk, commercial).

• Support enterprise-level planning for new products or expansions into the countries, advising on regulatory constraints and enablers.

• Help coordinate responses to supervisory reviews, information requests, and regulatory audits.

• Contribute to internal reporting and executive briefings on policy risks and regulatory trajectory within the region.

• Minimum of 5 years governmental affairs / regulatory affairs / legal experience ideally within the financial services or crypto-asset industry in South Africa.

• Experience engaging with regulators or government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team, to lead efforts in the Southern Africa Region. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the crypto-asset industry / stablecoin industry in the country, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, and regulatory requirements.
You will have a focus around working with regulators to translate policy objectives of the companies into favourable regulatory requirements in the applicable countries, as part of enabling the broader business strategy. From time to time, this may also include working on obtaining regulatory authorisations / approvals.
The successful candidate should be comfortable managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business, including regulators and policy setters, as well as working with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Finance, Technology, Business Development.
You will report to the Head of Regulatory and Licensing Affairs-Africa, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory and licensing initiatives.

Responsibilities
Regulatory Affairs

• Monitor regulatory developments impacting Tether and affiliates companies in the Southern Africa Region.

• Maintain active relationships with policymakers, regulators, central banks, and financial intelligence units.

• Represent the company in consultations, workshops, industry roundtables, and regulatory dialogues.

• Prepare briefing papers, comment letters, and policy submissions aligned with broader global regulatory strategy.

• Identify opportunities to shape emerging frameworks in a risk-sensitive, innovation-oriented manner.

Licensing & Authorisations

• Conduct structured assessments on whether licensing/registration is required for operations in the country.

• Lead or support licensing applications end-to-end - where needed - including preparation of supplementary documentation, legal opinion coordination, regulator communications, and post-submission follow-up.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Provide actionable risk and regulatory insights to internal stakeholders (legal, product, compliance, risk, commercial).

• Support enterprise-level planning for new products or expansions into the countries, advising on regulatory constraints and enablers.

• Help coordinate responses to supervisory reviews, information requests, and regulatory audits.

• Contribute to internal reporting and executive briefings on policy risks and regulatory trajectory within the region.

• Minimum of 5 years governmental affairs / regulatory affairs / legal experience ideally within the financial services or crypto-asset industry in South Africa.

• Experience engaging with regulators or government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 As an AI Filmmaker, you will leverage AI-based photo and video tools to conceptualize, create, and edit short films and videos. These videos will be used to tell stories, showcase products, and bring the visions of Tether and its affiliated companies to life. You’ll work closely within the marketing department to ensure that each video aligns with the brand’s message, tone, and visual style.

Responsibilities

• Create short films and videos using AI-driven photo and video generation tools.

• Edit and refine AI-generated content to produce high-quality, engaging visuals.

• Collaborate with the marketing team colleagues to develop video concepts for Tether, and other affiliated brands.

• Ensure all video content aligns with brand guidelines and communicates key messages effectively.

• Stay updated on the latest AI filmmaking tools and techniques, incorporating innovations into your workflow.

• Manage multiple projects with tight deadlines, ensuring timely delivery.

• Experiment with creative formats, styles, and effects to produce unique, memorable content.

• Proven experience in video production and editing, with a strong portfolio of work.

• Proficiency in AI video generation tools (e.g., Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E, or others).

• Expertise in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve).

• Creative storytelling skills with a keen eye for visual composition and detail.

• Ability to conceptualize and execute ideas quickly using AI tools.

• Familiarity with digital marketing and the ability to tailor content for social media platforms.

• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

• A passion for technology, bitcoin, and innovation is a plus.

What we offer
 Competitive compensation.
 Opportunity to work with a global team on cutting-edge projects.
 Flexibility to work remotely.
 Access to advanced AI tools and resources.
 A collaborative environment where your creativity will have a direct impact on the brand’s narrative.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the role:
 You will own the inference backbone behind QVAC's local AI stack: the C++ systems layer that makes models run fast, reliably, and predictably on real user hardware. The role is centered on engineering quality at runtime level, including startup behavior, memory pressure, throughput/latency balance, and long-session stability. You will define and evolve the core abstractions that inference features depend on, so new capabilities can be added without sacrificing performance or maintainability. This is a role for someone who enjoys low-level problem solving, clear technical ownership, and building infrastructure that other teams trust in production. Your work directly enables private, on-device AI experiences and helps set the technical foundation for QVAC's next generation of peer-to-peer AI products.

About the job
 You'll work on the C++ layer that powers local AI, porting and enhancing inference engines like llama.cpp or similar, to run efficiently on edge devices. Your focus is on the runtime: making models load faster, run leaner, and perform well across different hardware. You'll ensure that the inference layer is stable, optimized, and ready for integration with the rest of the stack.
 This role is for engineers who want to work close to the metal, enabling private and fast on-device AI without relying on cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• Work on deploying machine learning models to edge devices using the frameworks: llama.cpp, ggml

• Collaborate closely with researchers to assist in coding, training and transitioning models from research to production environments

• Integrate AI features into existing products, enriching them with the latest advancements in machine learning

• Strong programming skills in C++

• Strong experience with Llama.cpp and ggml inference engines, which facilitates the deployment of models to specific GPU architectures

• Experience with any GPU framework between Cuda, Vulkan, Metal, OpenCL

• Good understanding of deep learning concepts and model architectures

• Experience with transformers, LLMs, Diffusion models

• Demonstrated ability to rapidly assimilate new technologies and techniques

• A degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D

Bonus points if:

• You know how to train/fine-tune a LLM

• You have productionized models

• You have research experience in new model architectures

• You have experience with distributed systems

• Javascript experience

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally.
 The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology.
 Pear is a combined Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Runtime, Development & Deployment tool. Pear makes it possible to build, share and extend P2P applications using common Web and Mobile technology. Herein is everything needed to create unstoppable, zero-infrastructure P2P applications for Desktop, Terminal & Mobile.

• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.

• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities.

Technical Content & Enablement

• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.

• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.

• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.

• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions.

Product Evangelism

• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.

• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.

• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.

• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.

• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.

• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners

Thought Leadership

• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.

• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.

• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.

• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.

• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.

• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.

• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.

• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.

• Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love)

• Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems

• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement.

• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.

• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
