Rejoignez Tether et formez l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance : Notre suite de produits innovants présente le monde le plus fiable stablecoin, USDT, sur lequel s'appuyaient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques pionniers.
Mais c'est juste le début:
Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe.
Tether Data : Alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education: Démocratiser l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous habilitons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

À propos du travail :
Le contrôleur financier supervisera l'information financière, la coordination des audits et les opérations comptables dans le cadre d'une plateforme d'investissement et de trésorerie multientités. Le rôle exige un professionnel de la finance techniquement solide, doté d'une solide expertise comptable, d'une discipline opérationnelle solide et d'une capacité d'opérer dans un environnement à forte croissance rapide.

• Préparer en temps voulu des états financiers exacts, des comptes de gestion et des rapports justificatifs conformément aux IFRS et aux PCGR des États-Unis.

• Gérer les opérations comptables courantes dans plusieurs entités et administrations.

• Surveiller les processus de fin de mois, de fin de trimestre et de clôture de fin d'exercice, y compris les rapprochements du grand livre général et les examens de contrôle.

• Surveiller les créditeurs, les débiteurs, les charges à payer et les rapprochements de bilan.

• Diriger la coordination avec les vérificateurs externes, assurer la livraison en temps opportun des demandes de vérification, la documentation à l'appui et la résolution des problèmes.

• Appuyer la préparation de toute exigence de déclaration réglementaire, fiscale, législative et ad hoc.

• Renforcer et maintenir les contrôles internes, les politiques comptables et les cadres de gouvernance financière.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus comptables, des flux de travail et des contrôles opérationnels.

• Tirer parti de la technologie et de l'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité, l'évolutivité et la précision des rapports.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les opérations afin d'assurer l'intégrité des données et des rapports financiers.

• Aider à la mise en œuvre et à l'optimisation des systèmes financiers et de l'infrastructure de rapport.

• Appuyer l'analyse financière, les projets et les initiatives stratégiques au besoin.

Qualifications et expérience :

• Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finance ou un domaine connexe; certifications ACCA, ACA, CPA, CFA ou équivalent.

• 10 ans d'expérience en contrôle financier, audit ou comptabilité, de préférence dans un fonds de couverture de crédit. L'expérience antérieure en matière d'actifs numériques ou d'écosystèmes de blockchain est un avantage distinct.

• Compétence en gestion de portefeuille Xero et Enfusion.

• La compétence en Excel + VBA / Python est obligatoire.

• Capacités exceptionnelles d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

• Une bonne compréhension des exigences réglementaires et fiscales.

• Excellente attention aux détails et compétences en communication.

About the job
 Tether is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Internal Audit Manager to support the execution of its global internal audit program. The role involves independently assessing the effectiveness of internal controls, governance processes, and risk management practices across financial operations, business workflows, and technology systems.

Operating in a fast paced digital asset environment, the ideal candidate will have a strong background in operational and financial audits from a leading consulting or audit firm.

This role will serve as a key member of the Internal Audit Team, shaping strategic decisions, delivering risk based insights to senior stakeholders, and building a resilient risk culture that supports long term growth.

Responsibilities

Audit Planning & Execution

• Plan and execute risk based audits across financial, operational, and technology areas in line with the internal audit plan.

• Develop audit scopes informed by enterprise risk assessments and emerging threats.

• Lead walkthroughs and direct fieldwork with structured testing, sampling, and evidence standards.

• Oversee audit working papers and workflow documentation to professional standards.

Controls & Governance Assurance

• Evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls and risk management practices across processes and systems.

• Assess governance, policy adherence, and regulatory compliance.

• Test design and operating effectiveness of key controls and identify gaps across the firm’s lines of defense.

Technology & Systems Assurance

• Review critical systems and platforms for control design, security, and operational integrity.

• Assess application controls, access, change management, and data integrity.

• Provide independent assurance over new initiatives, system implementations, and emerging technology adoption.

Reporting, Remediation & Stakeholder Engagement

• Prepare audit reports and communicate findings to senior leadership and the Audit Committee.

• Provide practical, risk based recommendations and own remediation tracking through to closure.

• Collaborate with Finance, Technology, Risk, and Compliance to validate observations and escalate significant exposures.

Risk Culture & Continuous Improvement

• Promote a strong risk and control culture across the organization through audit engagement and awareness.

• Stay current on industry developments, emerging risks, and regulatory frameworks.

• Apply IIA standards and contribute to the evolution of audit methodologies and quality processes.

• Review critical systems and platforms for control design, security, and operational integrity.

About the job
 We're hiring a UX Researcher to work horizontally across Tether's full product portfolio from consumer apps like Keet, QVAC Workbench, and the Tether Wallet, to the developer portals and platforms behind QVAC, Pears, MDK, and WDK.
 This isn't a typical UX research role. The breadth is the point: one week you're studying how someone in Lagos uses USDt on their phone, the next you're sitting with engineers to figure out the best practice of developer portals. We need someone with genuine curiosity, depth of thinking, and the ability to communicate findings clearly enough that product designers and product managers make better decisions because of them. The goal is simple and never changes: the best possible experience for the user.

Responsibilities

• Run UX research across Tether's consumer and developer products: Keet, QVAC Workbench, Tether Wallet, developer portals, and more

• Identify UX best practices and emerging patterns across each product category

• Research competitors and adjacent products to surface how others are solving comparable problems, and where the gaps are

• Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product designers and product managers

• Partner with product teams across all four pillars (Stable Finance, Stable Intelligence, Stable Power, Stable Communications) to inform decisions at every stage of the product lifecycle

• Build and maintain a research repository so insights compound over time and are reusable across teams

• Tailor methods to each product qualitative, quantitative, lightweight, deep whatever the question actually needs

• 5+ years of UX research experience across consumer and/or developer products

• End-to-end research chops: defining the question, picking the method, executing, synthesizing, and communicating outcomes

• Strong command of qualitative methods (interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry) and working familiarity with quantitative ones

• Working knowledge of at least one of: crypto wallets and self-custody, messaging or P2P, AI applications, or developer tooling

• Sharp written and verbal communication — able to convert ambiguous findings into decision-ready recommendations

• Experience with products where trust, privacy, security, money movement, or technical complexity affect the user experience.

• Mandatory AI fluency: you must actively use AI tools to speed up research planning, synthesis, insight mapping, documentation, and reporting, while applying strong human judgement.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to convert messy findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership.

• Strong product judgement: able to separate signal from noise and identify which insights should influence the product.

• Comfortable working in fast-moving environments where research needs to be practical, focused, and useful.

• Genuine curiosity, critical thinking, and depth of analysis that goes beyond surface-level observations.

• Low-ego collaboration style, with the ability to challenge assumptions clearly and constructively.

• Genuine curiosity and depth of thinking that goes beyond surface-level observations

Bonus points:

• Background researching developer audiences and developer experience specifically

• Experience setting up UX research practices from scratch or scaling them across multiple product teams

• Background in fintech, crypto, AI, P2P, or open-source ecosystems

• Familiarity with privacy-preserving research methods

• Ability to create low-fidelity prototypes to demonstrate and inspire potential user flow , functionality and content structure improvements

About the job
 Program Manager with a solid background in the mining industry to lead and coordinate strategic initiatives in Central America. The role oversees the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple interrelated mining projects: spanning exploration, development, operations readiness, stakeholder engagement, and institutional relations and also ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and local community expectations.

Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end program management for mining initiatives in Central America, integrating exploration, technical studies, permitting, and operational readiness workstreams.

• Define program scope, objectives, milestones, budgets, and resource plans, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams (geology, engineering, environmental, legal, finance, community relations) and external consultants.

• Manage relationships with government authorities, regulators, and local institutions to advance permits, concessions, and policy engagement.

• Drive community and stakeholder engagement programs aligned with social license and ESG commitments.

• Monitor program risks, dependencies, and critical path; implement mitigation plans and escalate issues to the steering committee.

• Establish governance, reporting cadences, and KPIs across projects; produce executive-level updates.

• Oversee program budgets, capital expenditure tracking, and vendor/contract management.

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, international mining standards, and HSE requirements.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in Project/Program Management, Business, or related field preferred.

• Solid understanding of the mining lifecycle: exploration, feasibility, permitting, construction, and operations.

• 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.

• Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.

• Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.

• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.

• Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.

• Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.

• Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.

• Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments.

Preferred / Advantageous

• Prior experience operating in Central America.

• Familiarity with ESG frameworks, social performance standards (IFC PS, ICMM), and community development programs.

• Experience interacting with public-sector counterparts and multilateral institutions.

Important information for candidates

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
Program Manager with a solid background in the mining industry to lead and coordinate strategic initiatives in Central America. The role oversees the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple interrelated mining projects: spanning exploration, development, operations readiness, stakeholder engagement, and institutional relations and also ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and local community expectations.

Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end program management for mining initiatives in Central America, integrating exploration, technical studies, permitting, and operational readiness workstreams.

• Define program scope, objectives, milestones, budgets, and resource plans, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams (geology, engineering, environmental, legal, finance, community relations) and external consultants.

• Manage relationships with government authorities, regulators, and local institutions to advance permits, concessions, and policy engagement.

• Drive community and stakeholder engagement programs aligned with social license and ESG commitments.

• Monitor program risks, dependencies, and critical path; implement mitigation plans and escalate issues to the steering committee.

• Establish governance, reporting cadences, and KPIs across projects; produce executive-level updates.

• Oversee program budgets, capital expenditure tracking, and vendor/contract management.

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, international mining standards, and HSE requirements.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in Project/Program Management, Business, or related field preferred.

• Solid understanding of the mining lifecycle: exploration, feasibility, permitting, construction, and operations.

• 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.

• Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.

• Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.

• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.

• Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.

• Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.

• Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.

• Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments.

Preferred / Advantageous

• Prior experience operating in Central America.

• Familiarity with ESG frameworks, social performance standards (IFC PS, ICMM), and community development programs.

• Experience interacting with public-sector counterparts and multilateral institutions.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 We are looking for an automation-driven and hands-on People Technology Analyst whose primary mission will be to review, streamline, and automate our global People Operations processes. In this role, you will audit our existing workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and leverage our HR tech stack to build highly efficient, automated solutions while elevating our People Analytics capabilities.
 The ideal candidate has a passion for operational efficiency, an analytical mindset, and a proven track record of transforming fragmented, manual tasks into scalable, automated workflows that improve the overall employee and team experience.

Responsibilities

• Workflow Audit & Process Automation: Continuously map, review, and audit existing People Operations processes (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, contract changes, data updates) to identify inefficiencies. Design and implement automation strategies to eliminate manual tasks and friction points.

• HR Tech Stack Optimization: Act as the main system administrator for our HRIS (HiBob) and associated tools. Configure advanced automated workflows, custom triggers, alerts, and approvals to ensure seamless operations across global teams.

• System Integrations & Data Syncing: Oversee and optimize api-driven or native integrations between our HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee), and Finance tools (Payhawk) and others such Slack, Confluence and Harvest. Ensure data flows automatically and securely between platforms without requiring manual data entry.

• Data Governance & Analytics: Establish automated data validation rules to protect data integrity. Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and reports (tracking headcount, turnover, and talent acquisition metrics) to deliver real-time, actionable insights.

• Continuous Improvement & Scale: Stay ahead of HR technology trends and new feature releases within our existing tools (specifically HiBob updates) to proactively suggest and implement process improvements.

• User Enablement & Documentation: Create clear documentation for newly automated processes to ensure high adoption rates and self-sufficiency across the organization.

• Proven HR Tech Experience: 3+ years of experience managing, configuring, and deploying workflows in HRIS/ATS platforms within fast-growing or international environments.

• Process Optimization & Automation Mindset: Proven experience in business process mapping, workflow redesign, and implementing automation logic within HR ecosystems.

• HiBob & Recruitee Expertise: Direct experience configuring platform architecture, complex automated approval chains, and multi-conditional workflows in HiBob and Recruitee (or similar tools). HiBob experience will be a strong advantage.

• Data & Analytics Mastery: Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Google Sheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, PowerBI) to track process efficiency and HR metrics.

• Problem-Solving & Tech Savviness: Deep understanding of how software systems interact, including integration logic (APIs) and data mapping.

• Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Riguardo al lavoro Siamo alla ricerca di un analizzatore di tecnologia popolare guidato dall'automazione e pratico, la cui missione principale sarà quella di rivedere, semplificare e automatizzare i nostri processi operativi globali. In questo ruolo, verificherai i nostri flussi di lavoro esistenti, identificherai i colli di bottiglia manuali, e leverai il nostro stack di tecnologia HR per costruire soluzioni automatizzate altamente efficienti, aumentando al contempo le nostre capacità di People Analytics. Il candidato ideale ha una passione per l'efficienza operativa, una mentalità analitica, e una comprovata traccia record di trasformazione frammentata, compiti manuali in flussi di lavoro scalabili e automatizzati che migliorano l'esperienza complessiva dei dipendenti e del team. responsabilità
• Audit & Process Automation: mappa, revisione e verifica dei processi di gestione delle persone esistenti (ad esempio, onboarding, offboarding, modifiche dei contratti, aggiornamenti dei dati) per identificare le inefficienze. Progettare e implementare strategie di automazione per eliminare compiti manuali e punti di attrito.
• HR Tech Stack Optimization: agire come amministratore principale del sistema per il nostro HRIS (HiBob) e strumenti associati. Configurare flussi di lavoro automatizzati avanzati, trigger personalizzati, avvisi e approvazioni per garantire operazioni senza interruzioni in team globali.
• Integrazioni di sistema e sincronizzazione dei dati: supervisionare e ottimizzare le integrazioni api-driven o native tra il nostro HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee), e strumenti di finanza (Payhawk) e altri come Slack, Confluence e Harvest. Assicurare flussi di dati automaticamente e in modo sicuro tra piattaforme senza richiedere l'inserimento manuale dei dati.
• Gestione dei dati e analisi: stabilire regole di convalida automatizzate dei dati per proteggere l'integrità dei dati. Progettare, costruire e mantenere cruscotti e report automatizzati (tracking headcount, fatturato e metriche di acquisizione del talento) per fornire intuizioni in tempo reale, attuabili.
• Miglioramento continuo & Scale: Mantenere in anticipo le tendenze tecnologiche HR e le nuove versioni di funzionalità all'interno dei nostri strumenti esistenti (specificamente gli aggiornamenti HiBob) per suggerire e implementare proattivamente i miglioramenti del processo.
• Attivazione e documentazione dell'utente: creare una documentazione chiara per i processi automatizzati di recente per garantire elevati tassi di adozione e autosufficienza in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Prove HR Tech Experience: 3+ anni di esperienza di gestione, configurazione e distribuzione dei flussi di lavoro nelle piattaforme HRIS/ATS all'interno di ambienti in rapida crescita o internazionali.
• Ottimizzazione dei processi e automazione Mindset: comprovata esperienza nella mappatura dei processi aziendali, nella riprogettazione del flusso di lavoro e nell'implementazione della logica di automazione all'interno degli ecosistemi HR.
• HiBob & Recruitee Expertise: Esperienza diretta che configura l'architettura della piattaforma, complesse catene di approvazione automatizzate e flussi di lavoro multicondizionabili in HiBob e Recruitee (o strumenti simili). Esperienza HiBob sarà un forte vantaggio.
• Mastery: Forte mentalità analitica con competenza in Google Sheets e strumenti di visualizzazione dati (ad esempio, Looker Studio, PowerBI) per monitorare l'efficienza del processo e le metriche HR.
• Problem-Solving & Tech Savviness: profonda comprensione di come i sistemi software interagiscono, compresa l'integrazione logica (API) e la mappatura dei dati.
• Proficienza bilingue: La fluenza professionale in inglese (scritta e parlata) è obbligatoria. Informazioni importanti per i candidati Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:
• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.
• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali.
• Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io
• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente. Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

About the job
We are looking for an automation-driven and hands-on People Technology Analyst whose primary mission will be to review, streamline, and automate our global People Operations processes. In this role, you will audit our existing workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and leverage our HR tech stack to build highly efficient, automated solutions while elevating our People Analytics capabilities.
The ideal candidate has a passion for operational efficiency, an analytical mindset, and a proven track record of transforming fragmented, manual tasks into scalable, automated workflows that improve the overall employee and team experience.

Responsibilities

• Workflow Audit & Process Automation: Continuously map, review, and audit existing People Operations processes (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, contract changes, data updates) to identify inefficiencies. Design and implement automation strategies to eliminate manual tasks and friction points.

• HR Tech Stack Optimization: Act as the main system administrator for our HRIS (HiBob) and associated tools. Configure advanced automated workflows, custom triggers, alerts, and approvals to ensure seamless operations across global teams.

• System Integrations & Data Syncing: Oversee and optimize api-driven or native integrations between our HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee), and Finance tools (Payhawk) and others such Slack, Confluence and Harvest. Ensure data flows automatically and securely between platforms without requiring manual data entry.

• Data Governance & Analytics: Establish automated data validation rules to protect data integrity. Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and reports (tracking headcount, turnover, and talent acquisition metrics) to deliver real-time, actionable insights.

• Continuous Improvement & Scale: Stay ahead of HR technology trends and new feature releases within our existing tools (specifically HiBob updates) to proactively suggest and implement process improvements.

• User Enablement & Documentation: Create clear documentation for newly automated processes to ensure high adoption rates and self-sufficiency across the organization.

• Proven HR Tech Experience: 3+ years of experience managing, configuring, and deploying workflows in HRIS/ATS platforms within fast-growing or international environments.

• Process Optimization & Automation Mindset: Proven experience in business process mapping, workflow redesign, and implementing automation logic within HR ecosystems.

• HiBob & Recruitee Expertise: Direct experience configuring platform architecture, complex automated approval chains, and multi-conditional workflows in HiBob and Recruitee (or similar tools). HiBob experience will be a strong advantage.

• Data & Analytics Mastery: Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Google Sheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, PowerBI) to track process efficiency and HR metrics.

• Problem-Solving & Tech Savviness: Deep understanding of how software systems interact, including integration logic (APIs) and data mapping.

• Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rejoignez Tether et formez l'avenir du financement numérique Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innover avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques. Mais c'est juste le début: Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe. Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autorisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance et des opportunités mondiales. Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? Sur le travail Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste de la technologie des personnes axé sur l'automatisation et pratique dont la mission principale sera d'examiner, de rationaliser et d'automatiser nos processus d'exploitation des personnes à l'échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle, vous auditerez nos workflows existants, identifierez les goulets d'étranglement manuels et tirerez parti de notre pile de technologies RH pour construire des solutions hautement efficaces et automatisées tout en augmentant nos capacités d'analyse des personnes. Le candidat idéal a une passion pour l'efficacité opérationnelle, un état d'esprit analytique et une expérience éprouvée de transformation de tâches manuelles fragmentées en flux de travail évolutifs et automatisés qui améliorent l'expérience globale des employés et des équipes. Responsabilités
• Vérification des flux de travail et automatisation des processus : cartographier, examiner et vérifier en permanence les processus d'exploitation des ressources humaines existants (p. ex., à bord, hors-bord, changements contractuels, mises à jour des données) afin de déceler les inefficacités. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'automatisation pour éliminer les tâches manuelles et les points de friction.
• Optimisation de la pile HR Tech : agir en tant que principal administrateur système pour notre HRIS (HiBob) et les outils associés. Configurer les workflows automatisés avancés, les déclencheurs personnalisés, les alertes et les approbations pour assurer des opérations sans faille dans les équipes mondiales.
• Intégrations système et synchronisation des données : Surveiller et optimiser les intégrations api ou natives entre nos outils HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee) et Finance (Payhawk) et d'autres tels que Slack, Confluence et Harvest. Veiller à ce que les données circulent automatiquement et en toute sécurité entre les plates-formes sans nécessiter une saisie manuelle des données.
• Gouvernance et analyse des données: Établir des règles de validation des données automatisées pour protéger l'intégrité des données. Concevoir, construire et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord et des rapports automatisés (suivant le nombre d'employés, le chiffre d'affaires et les mesures d'acquisition de talents) pour fournir des renseignements en temps réel et exploitables.
• Amélioration et échelle continues : demeurez en avance sur les tendances de la technologie des RH et sur les nouveautés de nos outils existants (notamment les mises à jour HiBob) pour suggérer et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations proactives.
• Activation et documentation de l'utilisateur : Créer une documentation claire pour les nouveaux processus automatisés afin d'assurer des taux d'adoption élevés et l'autosuffisance dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Expérience éprouvée en RH Tech : 3+ ans d'expérience en gestion, configuration et déploiement de workflows sur les plateformes HRIS/ATS dans des environnements à croissance rapide ou internationaux.
• Optimisation et automatisation des processus Mindset: Expérience éprouvée dans la cartographie des processus d'affaires, la refonte des flux de travail et la mise en œuvre de la logique d'automatisation au sein des écosystèmes RH.
• Expertise de HiBob & Recruee : Expérience directe de configuration de l'architecture de la plateforme, des chaînes d'approbation automatisées complexes et des workflows multiconditionnels dans HiBob et Recruee (ou des outils similaires). L'expérience HiBob sera un avantage important.
• Data & Analytics Mastery: Forte mentalité analytique avec compétence dans les feuilles Google et outils de visualisation des données (par exemple, Studio Looker, PowerBI) pour suivre l'efficacité du processus et les paramètres RH.
• Problem-Solving & Tech Savviness: Compréhension approfondie de l'interaction des systèmes logiciels, y compris la logique d'intégration (API) et la cartographie des données.
• Compétence bilingue : La compétence professionnelle en anglais (écrite et parlée) est obligatoire. Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lors de la demande de rôles :
• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.
• Faites attention aux méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par le biais de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.
• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io
• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

jobs.title: People and Culture Analyst (100% REMOTE)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We are looking for an Analyst to join our People & Culture team and support data-driven People initiatives that enhance overall experience and talent management.
 You will provide essential support across the people lifecycle working closely with People Strategic Managers and cross-functional teams to detect early insights and contribute to a positive workplace environment.

Responsibilities
 Onboarding and Orientation

• Assist in coordinating the onboarding and orientation process to ensure new hires receive the necessary information and resources while creating an engaging experience.

• Provide logistical and administrative support for onboarding sessions and initial training.

• Conduct onboarding surveys and follow-up conversations to identify initial insights, escalating key findings to People Strategic Managers to support improvements.

Policy Compliance and Documentation

• Coordinate documentation process and compliance with internal policies with the People Operations Specialist.

• Maintain People & Culture Confluence pages, ensuring clear communication of existing policies and processes.

Training and Development Coordination

• Track completion of mandatory training modules and maintain accurate records of personnel training status.

• Analyze training surveys, escalating key findings to People Strategic Managers to support improvements.

Engagement and Support

• Support engagement initiatives defined by the People Strategic Management.

• Analyze Annual Engagement Survey, escalating key findings to People Strategic Managers to support improvements.

• Collaborate with Internal communication to foster People Engagement.

Data and Reporting

• Oversee and implement module workflows to optimize the use of the Core, Talent, and Learning modules on HiBob.

• Maintain People metrics on HiBob

• Prepare periodic reports with insights and trends according to Business needs

• 3–5 years of experience in People Assistant, People Experience or a similar role, ideally in a remote, fast-paced or tech-driven environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Hands-on experience with HR systems ideally HiBob,including setting, navigating and reporting.

• Writing, organizing, and managing documentation ideally in Confluence.

• Comfort working and building HR metrics and dashboards to support reporting and insights.

• Proactive, collaborative, resourceful, and detail-oriented, with a data-driven approach to problem-solving, process improvement and people approach.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
We are looking for an Analyst to join our People & Culture team and support data-driven People initiatives that enhance overall experience and talent management.
You will provide essential support across the people lifecycle working closely with People Strategic Managers and cross-functional teams to detect early insights and contribute to a positive workplace environment.

Responsibilities
Onboarding and Orientation

• Assist in coordinating the onboarding and orientation process to ensure new hires receive the necessary information and resources while creating an engaging experience.

• Provide logistical and administrative support for onboarding sessions and initial training.

• Conduct onboarding surveys and follow-up conversations to identify initial insights, escalating key findings to People Strategic Managers to support improvements.

Policy Compliance and Documentation

• Coordinate documentation process and compliance with internal policies with the People Operations Specialist.

• Maintain People & Culture Confluence pages, ensuring clear communication of existing policies and processes.

Training and Development Coordination

• Track completion of mandatory training modules and maintain accurate records of personnel training status.

• Analyze training surveys, escalating key findings to People Strategic Managers to support improvements.

Engagement and Support

• Support engagement initiatives defined by the People Strategic Management.

• Analyze Annual Engagement Survey, escalating key findings to People Strategic Managers to support improvements.

• Collaborate with Internal communication to foster People Engagement.

Data and Reporting

• Oversee and implement module workflows to optimize the use of the Core, Talent, and Learning modules on HiBob.

• Maintain People metrics on HiBob

• Prepare periodic reports with insights and trends according to Business needs

• 3–5 years of experience in People Assistant, People Experience or a similar role, ideally in a remote, fast-paced or tech-driven environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Hands-on experience with HR systems ideally HiBob,including setting, navigating and reporting.

• Writing, organizing, and managing documentation ideally in Confluence.

• Comfort working and building HR metrics and dashboards to support reporting and insights.

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

In this role, you will coordinate high-impact events for our various internal brands—ensuring each one reflects our world-class standards while maintaining its own unique brand identity.
 You won't just be working solo; you will be a vital part of our global events engine. When you aren't leading your own brand events, you will be the "right hand" to our senior team members on major international events.

Responsibilities

• End-to-End Execution: Lead the coordination of international events from initial concept and booth design through to on-site execution and post-event reporting.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison between global venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery.

• Logistics & Operations : Master the "fine print" by managing complex calendars, scheduling cross-functional meetings, overseeing intricate travel, event logistics, Finance & Budget coordination.

• Financial Oversight : Support the Expansion Team with budget reconciliation, expense tracking, and detailed performance reporting.

• Internal Logistics : Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate travel logistics.

• Global Communication : Manage both internal and external communications, ensuring the brand voice is consistent across English and Spanish-speaking markets.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Event Management or Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality & Tourism Management

• A willingness and availability to travel when required.

• Experience: 5+ years of proven success in global corporate events or the professional event industry.

• Linguistic Versatility: Native or full professional proficiency in English and Spanish is required. (Bonus points if you speak Italian).

• Tech-Savviness: Advanced proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office, with the ability to quickly adopt new project management tools.

• A solid grasp of budgeting, invoicing, and expense management.

About the job
 We're hiring an Influencer Marketing Manager to build and run Tether's influencer program .
 This isn't a typical influencer role. Half the work is the usual: identifying creators, building relationships, running campaigns, measuring impact, and creating affinity for Tether and our products. The other half is harder — we need someone who can credibly engage tech and developer influencers , because the developer audience is one of Tether's most important constituencies and it doesn't respond to standard marketing playbooks.

Responsibilities

• Build and own Tether's global influencer strategy across AI, tech, lifestyle, culture, health, crypto and more.

• Identify, vet, and build long-term relationships with influencers and creators solo and via agencies where it makes sense.

• Run end-to-end campaigns: brief, contract, ship, measure, iterate

• Partner with product teams across all four pillars (Stable Finance, Stable Intelligence, Stable Power, Stable Communications) to align influencer activity with what we're actually launching

• Develop the tech and developer influencer programme specifically YouTubers, technical bloggers, OSS maintainers, tech podcast hosts, AI influencers,

• Stay close to platform shifts like X, Rumble, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch,, and whatever comes next

• 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or comparable creator-side experience

• A real track record of campaigns you've run end-to-end, with results you can talk about

• Grow genuine familiarity with the tech and developer creator ecosystem — not just consumer-lifestyle

• Working knowledge of crypto, AI, or P2P/open-source enough to brief a creator without embarrassing yourself

• Sharp instincts for which creators are authentic and which aren't

Bonus points

• Existing relationships with developer influencers or technical content creators

• You've built an influencer program from scratch before

• You've worked with agencies in multiple regions and know how to manage them

• Build and own Tether's global influencer strategy across AI, tech, lifestyle, culture, health, crypto and more.

About the job
 Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain.

Responsibilities

• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.

• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.

• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.

• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.

• Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.

• Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.

• Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.

• Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.

• Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.

• Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.

• Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

• Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).

• Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.

• Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

• Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

• Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

• Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).

• Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.

• Additional languages and willingness to travel to project sites.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. A Tether, stiamo costruendo Hadron , la piattaforma di tokenizzazione aziendale che alimenta la prossima generazione di beni tokenizzati, stalloni, titoli, fondi, materie prime e beni del mondo reale (RWAs).

Stiamo cercando un Senior Software Engineer per contribuire a costruire l'infrastruttura di base dietro Hadron. Si lavorerà sui motori di tokenizzazione, le integrazioni blockchain, i quadri di autorizzazioni, i flussi di lavoro di emissione, gli strumenti di conformità e le API aziendali utilizzate da clienti istituzionali in tutto il mondo.
Questo è un ruolo ingegneristico pratico per qualcuno che gode di risolvere complesse sfide di sistemi distribuiti all'incrocio di blockchain, infrastrutture finanziarie e software aziendale.

responsabilità

• Contribuire alla documentazione e alle best practice di ingegneria

Competenze

• Forte competenza in Node.js ( stack di tecnologia primaria)

• Esperienza nella progettazione di API scalabili e sistemi backend distribuiti

• Forte comprensione di architetture cloud-native, microservizi e sistemi asincrono

• Esperienza con database relazionali e NoSQL

• Forte debug, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni e capacità di problem solving

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione inglese

Blockchain & Digital Assets

• Forte comprensione degli ecosistemi Ethereum e EVM

• Esperienza che interagisce con contratti intelligenti e flussi di transazioni blockchain

• Comprensione dell'architettura del portafoglio, dei flussi di firma e delle infrastrutture di asset digitali

• Familiarità con gli standard di token come ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 o standard di token di sicurezza

Bello da avere

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début:
Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autorisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance et des opportunités mondiales.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Chez Tether, nous construisons Hadron , la plate-forme de tokenisation d'entreprise qui alimente la prochaine génération d'actifs tokenisés, de monnaies stables, de titres, de fonds, de matières premières et d'actifs du monde réel (RWA).
Hadron permet aux institutions financières, aux gestionnaires d'actifs, aux bourses, aux gouvernements et aux entreprises d'émettre, de gérer et d'exploiter des actifs numériques réglementés sur plusieurs réseaux de blockchain tout en intégrant la conformité, les autorisations et les workflows opérationnels.
Nous cherchons un ingénieur logiciel senior pour aider à construire l'infrastructure de base derrière Hadron. Vous travaillerez sur les moteurs de tokenisation, les intégrations de blockchain, les cadres de permission, les workflows d'émission, l'outillage de conformité et les API d'entreprise utilisées par les clients institutionnels dans le monde entier.
Il s'agit d'un rôle d'ingénierie pratique pour quelqu'un qui aime résoudre des problèmes complexes de systèmes distribués à l'intersection de la blockchain, de l'infrastructure financière et des logiciels d'entreprise.

Responsabilités
Développement de la plate-forme de tokenisation

• Concevoir, construire et maintenir les services de moteur d'alimentation de la plateforme de tokenisation d'Hadron

• Élaborer des IPA à l'appui de l'émission d'actifs, de la gestion du cycle de vie, des mesures ministérielles et des opérations de jeton

• Bâtir une infrastructure évolutive pour les processus de tokenisation de qualité institutionnelle

• Contribuer à l'évolution de l'architecture d'Hadron et des capacités de la plate-forme centrale

Infrastructure de la chaîne de blocs

• Construire des intégrations avec Ethereum, les chaînes compatibles EVM et d'autres réseaux de blockchain pris en charge

• Mettre au point des services de manutention de jetons, de gravure, de transfert, de permission et d'opérations administratives

• Améliorer l'orchestration des transactions de blockchain, la signature des workflows et la fiabilité opérationnelle

• Contribuer aux intégrations de contrats intelligents et aux infrastructures de blockchain

Infrastructure des entreprises

• Élaborer des systèmes qui appuient les autorisations fondées sur le rôle, les approbations multisignatures, la vérification et les contrôles opérationnels

• Élaborer des intégrations avec les fournisseurs de garde, les fournisseurs d'identité et les services de conformité

• Améliorer l'évolutivité, l'observation, la surveillance et la fiabilité de la plateforme

• Automatisation du déploiement de l ' appui et outillage opérationnel

Collaboration interfonctionnelle

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produits, Ingénierie, Conformité et Solutions

• Traduire les besoins des clients institutionnels en capacités de plate-forme évolutives

• Participer aux examens d'architecture et à la planification technique

• Contribuer à la documentation et aux meilleures pratiques techniques

Compétences de base

• 5 ans et plus d'expérience en génie logiciel

• Forte expertise en Node.js (pile de technologie primaire)

• Expérience de conception d'API évolutive et de systèmes de backend distribués

• Une bonne compréhension des architectures cloud-natives, des microservices et des systèmes asynchrones

• Expérience des bases de données relationnelles et NoSQL

• Forte capacité de débogage, d'optimisation des performances et de résolution de problèmes

• Excellentes compétences de communication en anglais

Blockchain & Actifs numériques

• Expérience de la construction d'applications ou d'infrastructures basées sur la blockchain

• Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de l'Ethereum et du VEM

• Expérience en interaction avec les contrats intelligents et les flux de transactions de blockchain

• Compréhension de l'architecture du portefeuille, des flux de signature et de l'infrastructure des actifs numériques

• Connaissance des normes de jeton telles que ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 ou des normes de jeton de sécurité

Sympa d'avoir

• Expérience des plateformes de tokenisation ou de l'infrastructure d'émission

• Connaissance des normes de jeton telles que ERC-1400, restrictions de transfert, modèles de permissions et cadres de listes blanches

• Expérience des actifs numériques institutionnels, des fournisseurs de garde ou de l'infrastructure financière réglementée

• Expérience de l'intégration des fournisseurs KYC/AML et des flux de travail de conformité

• Familiarisation avec les marchés de capitaux, les valeurs mobilières, les fonds, les monnaies stables ou les actifs du monde réel

• Expérience de travail dans des organismes d'ingénierie à distance

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We need someone who is equally comfortable writing C and JavaScript. The Bare team builds and maintains the runtime itself along with a growing ecosystem of native modules (bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto, and many more). You would be writing native addons that bridge platform APIs into JavaScript, debugging across multiple operating systems, and helping keep the runtime small and correct. This is a hands-on systems role. You will work independently, own modules end to end, and ship code that runs on phones, laptops, servers, and constrained devices.

Native module development

• Design, implement, and ship bare-* native modules (e.g., bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto) end to end, including code, and tests

• Write C native addons that bridge platform APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem, crypto) into JavaScript

• Maintain and extend existing native modules based on product team requests and the bare-node compatibility list

Cross-platform builds and CI

• Set up and maintain cross-platform builds for macOS, Linux, Android (NDK), and iOS (Xcode)

• Own cross-compilation toolchain configuration for each target platform

• Maintain CI pipelines that build and test native modules across all supported platforms

• Investigate and fix platform-specific build failures and toolchain issues

Bare Runtime contributions

• Contribute to the Bare runtime core (module system, native addon system, light-weight threads)

• Help reduce the bare-node missing API surface

• Participate in evaluating and integrating alternative JS engines eg libjerry

Debugging and quality

• Debug native addon issues across multiple OS and device targets, including mobile

• Write and maintain tests for all modules

Collaboration and communication

• Respond to Bare team inquiries from internal teams and the public.

• Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions in writing .

• Participate in a weekly status call.

• Participate in Bare workshops and contribute to onboarding materials.

• Coordinate with product teams (Keet, WDK/Wallet).

• Strong C programming skills, including experience writing and debugging native code across platforms.

• Advanced JavaScript skills with a solid understanding of Node.js internals and the module ecosystem.

• Experience building native addons for Node.js or similar runtimes (N-API, node-gyp, or equivalent).

• Familiarity with libuv or other asynchronous I/O frameworks.

• Comfortable working across macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS build toolchains.

• Experience with cross-compilation and platform-specific system APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem).

• Ability to read and navigate large C and C++ codebases.

• Self-directed work style with strong written communication skills.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
